```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js and pnpm
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          make deps-copilot-client

      - name: Build TypeScript client
        run: |
          make copilot-client

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          make test-copilot-client

      - name: Extract Copilot version from constants.go
        id: extract_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep -o 'DefaultCopilotVersion.*=.*"[^"]*"' pkg/constants/constants.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "copilot_version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Validate Copilot version
        run: |
          echo "Using Copilot version: ${{ env.copilot_version }}"
          if [[ ! "${{ env.copilot_version }}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid Copilot version format"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: |
            ./copilot-client/test-results.xml
            ./copilot-client/coverage/lcov-report/index.html

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: ./copilot-client/coverage
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
```
